_comment: Expansion 6 H.1: assaults, battles through a living town (world/assaults.py, game/assault.py; docs/ADVENTURES.md 5.20, 8.15). A kind's clock is town minutes; `strike` is the kind of hosts.strike that resolves it in the abstract (threats.json hosts strike). Waves come in at their minute; a band's `group` is one encounter group or a list to choose from ('$main': the attacker's own group, when it has one), `count` the bands by tier (hamlet and village 1, town 2, city 3), `entry` gate | wall | portal (the square), `goal` folk (the nearest townsperson) | you | square | temple | keep | gate; `leader` marks the band whose fall breaks them. Fire is set by the first wave at `at` minutes in `seeds` places by tier. Demon bands come with Tieflings & Warlocks as more groups here.

raid: <danger>A horn sounds at the gate, and then the screaming starts: raiders are in {town}!</>
<danger>Smoke over the roofs of {town} and shouting from the gate: raiders!</>
<danger>Someone runs past crying that the raiders are in. Doors slam all down the street.</>
sack: <danger>The gates of {town} are down. Soldiers pour in, and they have come to take what they like.</>
<danger>A roar from the gate: {town} has fallen, and the sack begins.</>
<danger>Armed men in the streets of {town}, breaking doors. The town is being sacked.</>
the_dead: <danger>A bell rings and rings: the dead are over the wall of {town}!</>
<danger>Grey shapes come shambling up the lanes of {town}, and the living run before them.</>
<danger>Screams from the edge of {town}: the dead have come, as the old women said they would.</>
summoned: <danger>The air in the square of {town} splits with a sound like tearing cloth, and things climb out.</>
<danger>A ring of fire opens in the square of {town}, and something laughs on the far side of it.</>
<danger>Candles flare in the square of {town}, a chant rises, and the air goes wrong.</>
dragon: <danger>A shadow passes over {town}, and then the fire comes down.</>
<danger>A roar shakes the shutters of {town}. The dragon has come.</>
<danger>Wings like sails over the roofs of {town}, and the thatch bursts into flame.</>

raid: <danger>{town} is under attack: raiders in the streets, and smoke.</> You have come in the middle of it.
<danger>You come into {town} to screams: raiders are in the lanes.</>
<danger>The gate of {town} stands open and nobody guards it. Somewhere inside, people are fighting for their lives.</>
sack: <danger>{town} is being sacked as you come in.</> Soldiers break doors in the street ahead.
<danger>You come into {town} in the middle of its sack: fire, shouting, and men with torches.</>
<danger>The gates of {town} are broken, and the sack is going on inside.</>
the_dead: <danger>The dead walk the streets of {town}.</> You have come in the middle of it.
<danger>You come into {town} as the dead come through it: a bell ringing, people running.</>
<danger>Doors barred, a bell ringing, and grey things in the lanes of {town}. The dead are here.</>
summoned: <danger>Things from below are loose in {town}.</> A wrong light burns over the square.
<danger>You come into {town} to find its square split open and devils in the lanes.</>
<danger>A chant from the square of {town}, and small horned things running in the streets.</>
dragon: <danger>{town} burns under a dragon's wings.</> You have come in the middle of it.
<danger>You come into {town} as the dragon comes down on it.</>
<danger>Fire on the roofs of {town}, and the shadow of wings over the smoke.</>

wave: <danger>More of them are coming in by the {entry}!</>
<danger>Shouts from the {entry}: another band is in.</>
<danger>A fresh band comes in by the {entry}.</>
fire: <danger>Smoke rises over the roofs: they have set {town} alight.</>
<danger>Fire! A house is burning, and the wind takes it.</>
<danger>Flames climb a wall near the {entry}. They are burning the town.</>
broken: <good>Their leader has fallen, and the rest break and run.</>
<good>With their leader dead, the attackers lose heart and flee {town}.</>
<good>A cry goes up: their leader is down! The attackers scatter.</>
over: The attackers draw off from {town}, taking what they carry.
The fighting in {town} dies away; the attackers are gone.
It is over. The attackers leave {town} to count its dead.
left: You leave {town} behind you, and the sounds of it.
Behind you, {town} fights on without you.
The smoke of {town} follows you out onto the road.
